title: A complete solution to the directed Oberwolfach problem of order $2 \pmod{4}$ with cycles of even lengths
summary: The Oberwolfach problem asks for a $2$-factorization of the complete graph in which each $2$-factor is isomorphic to a specific factor $F$. Recently, this problem has been extended to directed graphs. In this case, the directed Oberwolfach problem asks for a directed 2-factorization of the complete symmetric digraph in which each directed $2$-factor is isomorphic to a specific directed factor $F$.
